scores.visual_critic_note: Restrained dark theme with a thoughtful CSS variable system, clear typographic hierarchy (bold title, small-caps panel labels, muted status text), and a purposeful single-accent palette — held back from 8 by the network graph being too dense to read node labels at rendered size and the thumbnail gallery becoming a visually undifferentiated mass of tiny images.
scores.encoding_integrity_note: Honest encoding throughout: scaleSqrt for node and color-point radii, zero-baseline bar chart with data-driven domain, monthly bins from d3.bin, no dual axes; minor issue: SVG label layer is not redrawn on filter and timeline data join lacks a key function.
scores.stress_test_note: RAF dirty-flag coalescing correctly defers all redraws, no cross-view dispatch loops, pointer events unify mouse/touch, and no D3 transitions requiring interrupt; however, bitFilter.set() O(N) data recomputation runs synchronously inside both brush event handlers on every mousemove before the RAF handoff, which can jank on the full 50K-block dataset.
scores.cognitive_load_note: Four linked crossfilter views are well-laid-out and the monochromatic palette avoids color overload, but the 60-node force network approaches spaghetti density and the thumbnail wall (50+ panels) shifts the bottom region from comparison to lookup.
